eyebrow.static: Eyebrow set to Static (eyebrow-static): Eyebrow text and Eyebrow link authored (topic / topicLink); blank text shows the linked page name, blank link falls back to the parent page of Link. Content without a saved mode is static when topic/topicLink is present
eyebrow.dynamic: Eyebrow set to Dynamic (eyebrow-dynamic, default): eyebrow shows the name of the Link's parent page and links to it; topic fields ignored
eyebrow.none: Eyebrow set to None (eyebrow-none): no eyebrow is rendered, including a legacy inline eyebrow in the Text field

capabilities.notes: content rows: image, text, topic, topicLink, link (ctaLink + ctaLinkText; CTA renders only when both are authored, no default text); eyebrow mode is the classes_eyebrow block option; the field rows are merged into the card at render time. Presentation and eyebrow mode are variant classes, not content rows. Single-image cards view only; carousel/facts views are not supported

suitableFor: article highlight sections with background image
promotional banners with overlay content card
left- or right-aligned overlay content cards (align-left / align-right)
